description: Soneri Bank Limited was established on 28 September 1991 as a full-service commercial bank. It operates more than 680 branches and ATMs across Pakistan, including over 200 Islamic banking branches, and its stated areas of operation are branch banking, corporate and investment banking, treasury, SME, financial institutions and Islamic banking. Its Islamic division, Soneri Mustaqeem, runs 119 dedicated Islamic banking branches alongside 15 Islamic banking windows.
headOffice: 10th Floor, PNSC Building, M.T. Khan Road, Karachi, Pakistan
